correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the 16-vertex XOR graph (differences 1,2,4,8,15) and exhaustively classified each of all 65,535 nonempty masks as an induced forest with maximum degree. Independently regenerated six ordered-element Morse matchings and topologically sorted every Hasse incidence: face counts 392/2142/7262/12542/13822/13838 and matching pairs 191/1070/3628/6270/6910/6911. Critical cells at d0,d1,d3,d4,d5 give wedges; d2 critical chain boundary is [[-1,-1,0],[-1,0,-1]] with a unimodular rank-two minor, giving S4 by 2-connected 4-complex cancellation. Independently checked the 96-term integral 4-cycle, 143-term integral 4-cocycle on all 4360 five-simplices and their pairing exactly -1. Both H4 groups Z, so the inclusion degree is a unit; factorization forces all 1→2→3→4 maps to be isomorphisms. Distinguish this exhaustively finite proof from any infinite family assertion.
